channel.title: 2026-08-31 AI × Science 文献日报 RSS
channel.description: 2026-08-31 当天筛选出的 AI × 物理 / 化学 / 材料交叉文献 RSS。

item.title: Mode-Specific Dynamics of CO2 Hydrogenation on Copper: The Hidden Role of Molecular Rotation
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Junfan Xia, Zhikai Jiang, Yaolong Zhang, Bo Peng, Hua Guo, Bin Jiang
基于全维第一性原理神经网络势，研究CO₂在Cu(111)表面的状态分辨氢化动力学。弯曲振动虽能增强反应性，但分子转动，尤其是过渡态附近分子极化取向各向异性的变化，发挥主导作用。

item.title: DFT and MLIP study of solute segregation to coherent and semi-coherent α-Fe/Fe₃C interfaces
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Amin Reiners-Sakic, Ronald Schnitzer, David Holec
结合DFT与通用机器学习原子势，研究珠光体中相干和半相干α-Fe/Fe₃C界面的溶质偏聚。错配位错显著增强多种元素的偏聚，且不同溶质对界面内聚和脆化的影响存在明显差异。

item.title: QGPINNs: A Physics-Informed Neural Network Framework for Nonlocal Differential Equations on Quantum Graphs
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Vaibhav Mehandiratta, Saket Ramchandra
提出QGPINNs，用图统一损失函数求解量子图上的非局部微分方程，并嵌入初始、边界及顶点传输条件。框架覆盖分数阶椭圆和时间分数阶演化问题，也支持从噪声观测中识别算子阶数与物理参数。

item.title: OrbGNN: A Wave function-based Machine Learning Interelectronic Representation
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Brody Quebedeaux, Shahzad Akram, Markus Reiher, Konstantinos D. Vogiatzis
提出基于轨道对相互作用和轨道纠缠图结构的电子结构模型OrbGNN。该模型将轨道相关性直接编码进图拓扑，并用于氮分子解离、双原子分子及八面体铁(II)配合物自旋态能隙预测。

item.title: 利用机器学习电子结构对MoS2/氧化物器件界面进行第一性原理建模
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Manasa Kaniselvan, Mauro Dossena, Denghui Lu, Alexander Maeder, Nicolas Vetsch, Alexandros Nikolaos Ziogas 等7位作者
本文提出一种用于模拟半导体器件的第一性原理方法，将可扩展的机器学习电子结构模型与先进量子输运求解器相结合。该框架在保持较高预测精度的同时，可将器件哈密顿矩阵的生成速度提高约10000倍，并处理含有超过20000个原子的器件。作者将其应用于显式纳入氧化物层的MoS2/氧化物样品和单层MoS2场效应晶体管，揭示了界面附近配位不足的Hf或Al金属原子对电子流大小及其在MoS2中传播的显著影响。

item.title: Compact Variational Neural Networks for Spectral Inference from a Single Nonlinear 2D Perovskite Photodetector
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Karl Jonas Riisnaes, Ned Thaddeus Taylor, Hoi Tung Lam, Rosanna Mastria, Francesco Saverio Difeo, Monica Felicia Craciun 等7位作者
arXiv:2608.27977v1 Announce Type: cross Abstract: Spectroscopy conventionally separates optical frequencies before detection, imposing persistent constraints on footprint, complexity and scalability. Here we establish an alternative paradigm in which the nonlinear optoelectronic dynamics of a single two-dimensional perovskite photodetector physically encode the incident optical field and machine learning performs the inverse spectral reconstruction. Using a planar fluorinated phenethylammonium lead iodide (F-PEAI) photodetector, we exploit wavelength- and irradiance-dependent current-voltage signatures arising from the coupled effects of photocarrier generation, trapping, interfacial transport and field-dependent carrier dynamics. A compact variational encoder-decoder preserves the functi…

item.title: uMOF：面向金属有机框架的通用数据库、基准与机器学习原子间势
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Théo Jaffrelot Inizan, Prathami Divakar Kamath, Alin Marin Elena, Kristin A. Persson
本文提出uMOF，包括迄今规模最大且精度最高的MOF密度泛函理论数据集、从文献中挖掘的经核验性质基准，以及两种通用MOF机器学习原子间势。该数据集涵盖85524个构型、19950种框架和79种元素，基准包含从626篇论文提取的3986个性质值。uMOF模型在近平衡性质上与现有模型相当，而在气体吸附焓和吸附等温线等动力学敏感性质上优于所有测试基线，将误差降低80%以上至实验不确定度范围内。

item.title: 用于高熵合金逆向设计的兼容 QUBO 主动学习
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Giorgio Silvi, Kirsten Bark, Rolando Reiner, Nicolas Vogt, Thomas Plehn, Daniel Barragan-Yani 等8位作者
本文提出一种兼容二次无约束二元优化（QUBO）的主动学习框架，用于高熵合金逆向设计，并将预训练图神经网络作为固定的性质预测器。研究表明，候选生成方式是搜索性能的主要决定因素，围绕高性能潜在编码进行局部扰动可带来最大的流程改进。该工作流与强经典优化策略具有竞争力，且学习得到的二次代理模型可直接导出为 QUBO。

item.title: Physics-informed learning for the inverse problem in resonant ultrasound spectroscopy
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Alejandro Cubillos Muñoz, Manuela Rivas, Julian Rincon
将共振超声谱弹性常数反演表述为物理可行弹性张量集上的受约束逆等谱问题。学习模型仅处理降维谱和几何特征，尺度恢复及弹性常数重构由解析约束完成。

item.title: Comparing Classical and Quantum Machine Learning for Regression in High Energy Physics Collision Data
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tariq Mahmood, Zain ul Abidin, Itzel Luviano Soto, Alfredo Raya
系统比较四类经典机器学习模型与对应量子模型在高能物理碰撞数据回归中的表现。经典CNN和LSTM略占优势，而QCNN以四个量子比特和三层电路达到接近深度CNN的精度，体现参数效率。

item.title: Physics-Informed Hybrid Stochastic-AI Framework Integrating Galle and Woods Mechanics, Monte Carlo Simulation, and Dual-Track AI Decision Support for ROP Optimization, Cutter Wear Mitigation, and NPT Reduction: A Tawakul-1 Well Case Study (Block-8, Sudan)
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Ahmed Abdelaziz Ibrahim Elrayah, Mohamed Elamin Ali Ahmed, Ahmed Abdalbagi Mohammedahmed Mohialdeen, Hala Yousif Daffallah Ali, Ali Dagrashawi Ali Mohamed
构建融合Galle-Woods力学、蒙特卡洛模拟、XGBoost与大语言模型的钻井参数决策框架，并以苏丹Tawakul-1井为案例验证。框架在考虑钻头磨损和不确定性的同时，为ROP优化与风险控制生成操作区间。

item.title: Interstitials as a key ingredient for P segregation to grain boundaries in polycrystalline α-Fe
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Amin Reiners-Sakic, Alexander Reichmann, Christoph Dösinger, Lorenz Romaner, David Holec
研究多晶α-Fe模型中磷在晶界替位和间隙位点的偏聚行为。磷平均偏聚能更偏向替位点，但间隙位点数量丰富，对晶界磷富集仍有重要贡献。

item.title: Automated Dislocation Detection in Electron Channelling Contrast Imaging: A Comparative Study of Rule-Based, Neural Network, and Deep Learning Approaches
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 A. Holmes, C. Trager-Cowan, J. Bruckbauer, B. Hourahine
比较规则视觉方法、CNN多阶段方法和YOLOv8对GaN电子通道衬度图中位错的自动检测能力。YOLOv8结合自适应高斯分块尺寸策略，在7451个位错上取得98.6%的计数准确率及98.7%的精确率和召回率。

item.title: 利用物理信息神经网络重建广义 Barrow 全息暗能量
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Spyros Basilakos, Andronikos Paliathanasis, Emmanuel N. Saridakis, Stylianos A. Tsilioukas
Barrow 全息暗能量将宇宙加速与由 Barrow 指数 Δ 表征的视界熵量子引力形变联系起来。本文利用 Cosmo-PINN 框架，结合 PantheonPlus 超新星、DESI DR2 重子声学振荡和宇宙计时器数据，在不预设函数形式的条件下重建 Δ(z)。结果显示 Δ 随红移呈温和、平滑的演化，后验均值偏向负值，但 Δ=0 及恒定负值仍与当前不确定性相容。

item.title: Energy relaxation due to two-phonon scattering of electrons: Breakdown of the energy diffusion model
item.description:
📚 Phys. Rev. B
👤 Joshua Covey, Dmitrii L. Maslov
论文聚焦电子通过双声子散射产生的能量弛豫问题。研究主题涉及量子顺电体和高温超导铜酸盐中的能量弛豫，以及能量扩散模型的失效。

item.title: Examining the robustness of Physics-Informed Neural Networks to noise for Inverse Problems
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Aleksandra Jekic, Afroditi Natsaridou, Signe Riemer-Sørensen, Helge Langseth, Odd Erik Gundersen
比较PINN与有限元结合数值优化方法在含高斯噪声逆问题中的表现，考察Burgers方程和Taylor-Green涡旋中的黏度识别。PINN在人力投入和专业知识需求方面更简便，但精度通常较低，且随问题计算复杂度增加表现出更好的扩展性。

item.title: A Gaussian-based spatially weighted loss formulation for Physics-Informed Neural Networks with Shocks
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Kheir-eddine Otmani, Abdelhalim Azzouz, Nourelhouda Groun, Esteban Ferrer
提出由PDE残差动态驱动的高斯空间加权损失，使PINN在无需重采样或预设震波位置的情况下聚焦局部高梯度区域。该方法在低黏性Burgers问题和二维Euler黎曼问题中均改善了震波解析效果。

item.title: A Scoping Review of Physics Informed Machine Learning for Wave Propagation Modeling in Seismology
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Óscar Rincón-Cardeño, Gregorio Pérez-Bernal, Silvana Montoya-Noguera, Nicolás Guarín-Zapata
综述物理信息机器学习在地震波传播正演和反演中的应用，并按问题类型与学习策略梳理研究趋势。文章认为该方法可作为逆问题和代理建模的补充工具，但基准一致性、训练成本及三维和真实条件下的可扩展性仍需改进。

item.title: The Discrete-Log Clock: How a Transformer Learns Modular Multiplication
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Huu Danh Nguyen
指出以加法离散傅里叶变换分析模乘学习机制会掩盖其结构，转而采用乘法特征变换。对模113乘法任务的分析显示，模型在离散对数空间中将乘法化为加法，并呈现稀疏且可解释的频率与神经元结构。

item.title: Low-Altitude Fluid Antenna Network with Multi-Agent Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Tong Zhang, Yanfei Su, Shuai Wang, Wanli Ni, Chengzhong Xu, Huseyin Arslan
提出面向低空流体天线网络的电磁数字孪生辅助多智能体强化学习框架，并设计两阶段迁移学习以缩小仿真到现实的差距。案例研究表明，联合优化天线位置和波束成形可使系统和速率较固定位置基线提升118.5%。

item.title: 功函数与高覆盖度吸附能作为 Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 合金析氢反应描述符
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Zacharias Liasi, Ridha Zerdoumi, Felix Thelen, Geovane Arruda de Oliveira, Rico Zehl, Natalia Pukhareva 等11位作者
本文考察裸表面功函数是否能继续作为成分复杂表面的析氢活性描述符，并将其与覆盖度修正的氢吸附能进行比较。基于三组 Ag-Au-Pd-Pt 薄膜组合材料库，研究发现功函数和覆盖度修正吸附模型都能解释大部分活性变化，二者结合时拟合效果最高。由于功函数与覆盖度修正吸附能在这四种金属中呈现相似趋势，同时使用二者相较单独使用其中任一指标的额外收益有限。

item.title: Casimir-electrostatic pull-in in nanoelectromechanical actuators: Differentiable design sensitivities and the damping-dependent collapse boundary
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 N. S. Akintsov, A. P. Nevecheria, S. N. Andreev, Qing-Hua Qin
采用快速度坐标训练物理信息神经网络，描述静止状态和有限阻尼下的纳米机电执行器吸合边界，并获得可微设计灵敏度。研究证明从静止出发的塌缩边界受阻尼影响，且在特定阻尼比处与准静态折叠边界合并。

item.title: 量子系统的元学习特征与动力学
item.description:
📚 Phys. Rev. Research
👤 Lucas Schorling, Pranav Vaidhyanathan, Jonas Schuff, Miguel J. Carballido, Dominik Zumbühl, Gerard Milburn 等10位作者
本文探讨用于量子系统的元学习方法，其目标是利用先前数据中获得的知识，适应可用数据较少的新系统。与面向单个特定量子系统预测或控制的常见机器学习方法相比，元学习具有更强的跨系统适应潜力。所给摘要被截断，具体方法和结果需查阅原文。

item.title: Voltage and Electromagnetic Fault Injectioin in TinyML: Attacks and Countermeasures
item.description:
📚 Preprints
👤 Srilalith Nampally, Anthony Etim, Aubtin Rasouli, Dustin Mazza, Tinghung Chiu, Ferhat Erata 等9位作者
通过电压毛刺和电磁故障注入实验，研究微控制器上TinyML模型对隐蔽故障攻击的脆弱性。四类模型的推理准确率均会下降，随机自约简与中间值多数投票可用于防护。

item.title: Real-time virtual circuits for plasma shape control via neural network emulators: experimental demonstration on MAST Upgrade
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Nicola C. Amorisco, Kamran Pentland, Adriano Agnello, George K. Holt, Alasdair Ross, Matthew J. Marshall 等15位作者
在MAST Upgrade装置上首次实验部署实时虚拟回路，以神经网络等离子体响应代理在线更新控制线性化模型。不同等离子体场景的实验表明，该方法能够在现有控制系统中实现形状控制，并减少对预设、场景专用调度的依赖。

item.title: Accelerated design of proton exchange membranes for green hydrogen production with artificial intelligence
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Huan Tran, Akhlak Mahmood, Harshal Chaudhari, Kuldeep Mamtani, Chiho Kim, Rampi Ramprasad 等8位作者
提出以虚拟正向合成和机器学习性质预测相结合的质子交换膜设计策略，用于筛选无氟替代材料。该方法从数百万种可合成聚合物中进行评估，并据此设计出1700多种候选膜。

item.title: Video Generative Models as Geometry Learner
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Haosen Yang, Jifei Song, Zhensong Zhang, Xiatian Zhu, Jiankang Deng
将预训练视频生成模型重新用于几何估计，把深度和表面法向预测统一表述为下一帧生成任务。GeoNeXt在多数据集零样本评测中优于既有生成式方法，并以更少训练数据接近使用百倍以上数据训练的判别式模型。

item.title: MaCoPlanner: LLM-Assisted Manual-Compiled Task Planning with Proactive Safety Verification for Robotic Industrial Panel Operation
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Guipeng Xin, Jiahe Xua, Mohammad Deghat, Chenhui Wan, Jie Liu, Youmin Hu 等7位作者
提出MaCoPlanner，将设备手册编译为带类型中间表示，并在执行前对候选计划进行符号展开和程序、状态约束验证。框架可定位违规并定向修复，在控制面板模拟器中提升了不同难度任务的成功率。

item.title: InfoMamba: An Attention-Free Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Youjin Wang, Jiaqiao Zhao, Rong Fu, Run Zhou, Ruizhe Zhang, Jiani Liang 等8位作者
提出无注意力的InfoMamba，将概念瓶颈线性滤波层作为全局信息接口，并通过信息最大化融合注入选择性状态空间流。实验显示，该模型在多类任务上优于强基线，同时保持接近线性的扩展能力。

item.title: Can Subgraph Explanations Be Weaponized to Steal Graph Neural Networks?
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Ojas Nimase, Jiate Li, Yue Zhao, Yushun Dong
提出面向严格黑盒图分类模型的模型窃取攻击，利用解释子图引导边敏感性估计和决策边界搜索。研究表明，仅凭离散类别标签与二值解释掩码，解释接口也可能形成可利用的攻击面。

item.title: HARTS: Efficient Agentic Reinforcement Learning for Hybrid-Attention Models over Arbitrary Rollout Trees
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Boyuan Meng, Peihua Bao, Hong Liu, Xiaowei Zhu, Chao Wang, Gen Li 等7位作者
提出HARTS，通过前缀压缩、打包执行和状态恢复，减少混合注意力模型在任意强化学习展开树上的共享历史重复计算。其在SWE-bench生成的智能体强化学习任务中取得4.81至4.87倍训练加速，数值差异与基线重跑波动相当。

item.title: Probabilistic Symbolic Regression for Equation Discovery via Operator-induced and Regularized Symbolic Forests
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Somjit Roy, Pritam Dey, Bani K. Mallick, Debdeep Pati
提出以符号树集成表示表达式的概率符号回归框架，并用拓扑先验控制复杂度、用后验摘要刻画模型不确定性。理论上给出后验集中性结果，实验中兼顾预测准确性、符号简洁性和结构稳定性。

item.title: The Autonomy Tax: Defense Training Breaks LLM Agents
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Shawn Li, Yue Zhao
研究防御训练对多步大语言模型智能体能力与安全性的影响，覆盖97项智能体任务和1000条对抗提示。结果发现，防御训练可能导致工具执行失效、错误级联和防御绕过，使智能体在保持抗攻击性的同时难以维持任务可靠性。

item.title: VICT: Verifier-Instrumented Credit Tracing for Long-Horizon LLM Agent Reinforcement Learning
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Pengcheng Li, Zhengyang Zhang, Dongxu Zhang, Sui Huang, Shaohua Ma
提出VICT，将终端验证器中的可执行或有证据支持的原子检查沿依赖关系追溯至具体动作，以细化长程智能体强化学习的信用分配。该方法保留终端奖励，无需学习评论家或额外分支 rollout，并在ALFWorld和WebShop上优于仅使用结果奖励的…

item.title: Is Monte Carlo Tree Search Just Every-Visit Monte Carlo Control?
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Xianyi Wu
arXiv:2608.27985v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Monte Carlo Tree Search (MCTS) and every-visit Monte Carlo (MC) control are usually presented as different methods. MCTS is described in the language of search (selection, expansion, simulation, and backup), whereas MC control is described in the language of reinforcement learning (trajectory sampling, return estimation, action-value updating, and policy improvement). This note argues that, at the level of trajectory generation and action-value updating, the distinction is largely terminological. The tree policy and rollout policy can be viewed as the learned and not-yet-learned parts of a single evolving policy; expansion corresponds to first visit and initialization; and backup is the ordinary every-visit Monte Carlo update. Under this int…

item.title: Electronic structure, magnetic interactions, and magnonics of 2D trichloride materials
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Krishna Prasad Chapai, Yogendra Limbu, Gopi Chandra Kaphle, Durga Paudyal
arXiv:2608.27747v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Using advanced density functional theory, this study demonstrates the robust thermodynamic, structural, and dynamical stability of pristine, 3d-doped (Ti, Cr), and 4f-doped (Ce) transition metal trichlorides (MCl3). While standard generalized gradient approximation (GGA) incorrectly predicts metallic behavior, hybrid functional calculations successfully capture their semiconducting nature, yielding accurate band gaps of 2.54 eV (VCl3), 4.01 eV (CrCl3), and 2.61 eV (TiCl3). These materials exhibit intrinsic ferromagnetism, with CrCl3 displaying overlapping topological features in both its magnon and phonon dispersions along the high-symmetry K direction, which induces magnon-phonon coupling. Incorporating 3d dopants into VCl3 successfully tun…

item.title: 软非谐晶格中的能带型载流子：卤化铅钙钛矿
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 Young Mi Lee, Inhee Maeng, Jinwoo Park, Seung-Jae Oh, Min-Cherl Jung
卤化铅钙钛矿APbX3具有显著矛盾性：其晶格极软且强非谐，却表现出能带型电子输运和较长的载流子扩散距离。本文提出统一微观图像，认为受Pb 6s2孤对电子强烈影响的软、强非谐且极性的[PbX3]-骨架，同时决定带边反键轨道、介电响应与载流子弛豫动力学。文章据此讨论激子、大Fröhlich极化子、输运、缺陷容忍性及对称性破缺，并评估若干争议问题和开放问题。

item.title: Emergent chiral symmetry breaking in moiré domain walls redirects topological boundary states in graphene
item.description:

📚 arXiv
👤 Rintaro Makino, Mihiro Kubo, Keiichirou Yonezawa, Hiroyuki Yoshida, Satoshi Kera
arXiv:2608.27890v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Phenacenes, in which benzene rings are fused in a zigzag manner, are chemically robust π-conjugated hydrocarbons of interest for organic electronic applications and superconductivity. However, quantitative electronic parameters of phenacene thin films remain limited compared with those of acenes. Here, we determine the ionization energies (IEs), electron affinities (EAs), band gaps, exciton binding energies, and polarization energies of orientation-controlled thin films of picene, [6]-phenacene, and [7]-phenacene using ultraviolet photoelectron spectroscopy and low-energy inverse photoelectron spectroscopy. item.title: ScatterWorks: A Python package for building and solving scattering network models
item.description:
📚 arXiv
👤 R. Johanna Zijderveld, Hélène Spring, Anton R. Akhmerov
arXiv:2608.28479v1 Announce Type: new Abstract: Network models provide an efficient framework for studying non-interacting transport and wave-propagation phenomena in disordered and topological systems. We introduce ScatterWorks, an open-source Python package for building and solving network models. The package uses a compact network representation with composable transformation operations (tile, cut, relink, and union) to enable flexible construction of periodic and finite networks. Local scattering matrices on nodes can be assigned by node labels or explicit indexing, assembled into global scattering equations, and used to compute quasienergies and transport observables.
